minduration.description: Minimum audio ad duration in seconds.

maxduration.description: Maximum audio ad duration in seconds.

poddur.description: Total time in seconds for a dynamic audio ad pod.

startdelay.description: Start delay in seconds for pre-roll, mid-roll, or post-roll ad placements.

rqddurs.description: Precise acceptable durations for audio creatives in seconds.

podid.description: Unique identifier indicating an impression belongs to an audio ad pod.

podseq.description: The sequence (position) of the audio ad pod within a content stream.

slotinpod.description: Guaranteed delivery position in the pod.

mincpmpersec.description: Minimum CPM per second for the dynamic portion of an audio ad pod.

maxextended.description: Maximum extended ad duration if extension is allowed.

companionad.description: Array of Banner objects if companion ads are available.

maxseq.description: Maximum number of ads in an ad pod.

stitched.description: Indicates if the ad is stitched with audio content.

durfloors.description: Floor prices for audio creatives of various durations.

ext.description: Placeholder for exchange-specific extensions to OpenRTB.

sequence.description: DEPRECATED. Use slotinpod instead. Position in ad pod sequence.
